title: CppIndia Tech Talk — January 2027
speaker: Mahendra Bhagwan Garodi
topic: SIMD in Modern C++: From Intrinsics to std::simd
description: Mahendra Bhagwan Garodi has 10+ years of experience building virtual platforms in the semiconductor industry, modelling CPUs, memories and SoC peripherals. In this session he walks through vectorising C++ code, from hand-written intrinsics to the portable std::simd API, and how to measure whether it actually got faster.

title: CppIndiaCon 2024
description: India's 4th annual C++ conference with 8 international speakers including experts from think-cell.

title: Time Travel Debugging Hackathon 2023
description: Hosted by CppIndia with Undo. Participants nominated by C++ communities worldwide raced to debug problems in a time-bound environment using UDB. The winner received a gift card, Undo swag and a 6-month UDB licence, plus $250 for their community; every participant got a 60-day UDB licence.

title: CppIndia Logo Contest
description: An open call for the community to design a new CppIndia logo for social media, the website and print (stickers, t-shirts, cups). Submissions closed on 11 June 2021; the winner received a shout-out and a surprise reward.
